Compute it: Primary null. `H0`: the pooled trajectory is what the fixed network would have shown. Cluster bootstrap over the 64 panel stations — resample 64 *with replacement*, carry each station's entire era-by-era Jun–Sep observation set, recompute Δ_fixed(e) = med(e) − med(1985–1989). 5,000 replicates give a percentile band per era; reject `H0` where Δ_pooled(e) falls outside the 95% band.
